The '''''Starworm''''' was a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]].

==History==
The vessel was destroyed in a battle near [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was left adrift as a derelict. The remainder of the ship was partially valuable, with intact [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] standing between any salvagers hoping to make potential finds.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

The [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] gunrunner and Clone Wars veteran [[Sude Raalo]] offered a group of salvagers 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to enter the wreckage and reclaim whatever valuables they could find. The group faced opposition from [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] sent by a rival salvager named [[Geelo]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
